desc: The PMAG AK74 MOE is an inexpensive, lightweight, high reliability polymer magazine designed for Kalashnikov pattern rifles in 5.45x39mm (AK74, MPi-AK-74N,PA md. 86, and others.) It features a removable floorplate, constant curve geometry, and a high-reliability/low-friction follower for the affordable performance you expect from a MOE PMAG. Magazine counts as three US compliance parts for 922r. Made in U.S.A.
